=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:736-743 (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:443-447) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the close-race check fails, upsert now logs `OPERATOR_STEP_RESOLVE ... reason=recheck_failed` to stderr and exits 0, and the `outcome=reopened reason=entry_after_close` line also exits 0; activation_verify.sh writes this output to "${RUNTIME_DIR}/operator_step_issue.log" and prints that file only when upsert fails, so these contractual lines never reach the workflow log.
  WHY: A new entry can be left in a closed tracker, and resolve and the next upsert only list open trackers (operator_step_issue.py:386-388), so a second tracker can be created; neither operators nor log analysis keyed on the stable prefix can detect this. All reviewers rated this NIT, mapped to low.
- tests/test_operator_step_issue.py:(Multiple tests, e.g., test_needs_human_digest_park_creates_the_digest_with_operator_step_label) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push test gate lists these tests as failing because of this PR's changes.
  WHY: The updated FakeGitHub PATCH behaviour may break existing tests that relied on the old tracking-state update behaviour. Rated MAJOR, mapped to high. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said in their notes that the failures are environmental: the sandbox checkout is missing .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:670-697 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: resolve treats any trusted entry with an unticked box and a source SHA as eligible for automatic ticking, and activation verify attaches the merge SHA to every operator gap, including human-action gaps such as setting secrets or repository settings (caller scripts/activation_verify.sh:722, 734-738).
  WHY: Once the merged PR is contained in stable, resolve ticks human-action entries without checking that the action was done and can close the tracker while operator work is still pending. Rated MAJOR, mapped to high.

  PROBLEM: The last run turned a failed close-race check from exit 2 into a stderr log line plus exit 0. The caller writes that stderr to "${RUNTIME_DIR}/operator_step_issue.log" and prints the file only when upsert exits non-zero, so the "OPERATOR_STEP_RESOLVE ... reason=recheck_failed" and "outcome=reopened reason=entry_after_close" lines never reach the workflow log, even though the agents.d fragment lists upsert as an emitter of this contractual prefix.
  WHY: In the residual race documented at operator_step_issue.py:439-442, the tracker can stay closed with a new unticked entry. resolve and the next upsert only list open trackers (line 387), so a second tracker is created and nothing in the workflow log shows it.
- HARDENING (scripts/activation_verify.sh, right after the successful upsert call, line 743): grep '^OPERATOR_STEP_RESOLVE ' "${RUNTIME_DIR}/operator_step_issue.log" || true, and emit a ::warning:: when the output contains reason=recheck_failed; about 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- NOTES (4 related items): the gemini test-failure claim is rejected because FakeGitHub's branches (tests/test_operator_step_issue.py:59-65, 66-72, 83-88) do not affect the digest paths, and the real cause is the missing .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:258); the other gate failures come from the sandbox missing .claude/ and .github/ai/; the copilot reviewer failed with HTTP 422 custom_instructions_too_large in its own setup; the release-wait match at scripts/activation_verify.sh:178 and the resolve log-then-re-raise path were verified as correct.
